findings.correction: “Damn, have you been doing nothing but this?”
findings.current: “Damn, did you do nothing but this after you ate?”
findings.defect: 밥 먹고 ~만 하다 is an idiom for doing nothing else with one’s life, not an action after a meal.
findings.rationale: The line praises obsessive specialization. Post-meal wording invents a lunch break the source does not mention.

findings.defect: 혀를 내두르다 is astonishment; tongue-clicking is 혀를 차다 and reads as disapproval.
findings.rationale: He is reacting to Taekyung’s nonstop butchering, then calling him a tough bastard. A click reverses the affect.

findings.correction: Team Leader Choi was sent flying back. With a twisted expression, he said,
findings.current: Team Leader Choi was knocked back. He landed quickly and spoke with a twisted expression.
findings.defect: 빠르게 modifies being flung back. “Landed quickly” is added and reassigns the adverb.
findings.rationale: The black mass slams his side; the next beat is the grim line to stop it, not a controlled quick landing.
findings.source: 빠르게 튕겨 나온 최 팀장이 일그러진 얼굴로 말했다.

findings.correction: “If we take out the Priest first, there’s hope. In exchange…”
findings.current: “If we take out the Priest first, there’s hope. But…”
findings.defect: 그 대신 signals a tradeoff/cost, not a generic contrast.
findings.rationale: The interrupted catch is the price of hope; the next lines assign the party to hold the Great Warrior while Choi moves.
findings.source: “제사장을 먼저 처리한다면 희망이 있습니다. 그 대신…….”

findings.defect: 여러분들이 is plural and excludes Choi. Bare You can read as Im alone.
findings.rationale: Choi answers 우리가요? by pushing the hold onto the rest of the party, then recasts Haste himself.

findings.correction: Im Kkeokjeong, who had sidled over at that speed, even dropped his mouth open.
findings.current: Im Kkeokjeong, who had quietly approached at my speed, even gaped.
findings.defect: 빠른 속도에 is why he sidles over, not the speed of his approach.
findings.rationale: He is drawn by the butchering pace; “at my speed” can mean he himself moved that fast.
findings.source: 빠른 속도에 슬쩍 다가온 임꺽정도 입을 벌렸다.

findings.defect: 비켜 is clear the path for a charge, not a generic relocate.
findings.rationale: Im is about to rush the restored gate with the tower shield; the command is to make space.

findings.correction: Zoning out in the middle of a raid.
findings.current: Who was I to let my mind wander during a raid?
findings.defect: Adds the English idiom “who was I to,” which frames unworthiness rather than the source’s “I’ve lost it / I zoned out.”
findings.rationale: The preceding line is 내가 단단히 미쳤구나; this fragment continues that self-rebuke, not a rights claim.

summary: Several semantic mismatches: a meal-time calque for 밥 먹고 ~만, 혀를 내두르다 rendered as a tongue-click, knockback speed reattached to landing, 그 대신 reduced to a generic But, and 여러분들이 flattened to ambiguous You.
